$comment: Replica of NgocthuCac's own architecture: the main deployment holds only the 40 base files; lesson content lives on Mingyu's sibling Vercel projects and is served here through rewrites (same mount -> same project mapping as module-links.js). The 1 GB of lesson files downloaded on 2026-11-17 is kept as a local backup in this directory and is NOT pushed to GitHub: Vercel Hobby caps CLI uploads at 100 MB and the GitHub snapshot push cannot carry binary files.
